blockers.description: Older add-on releases use open-ended API requirements and may resolve a stable API 1.0.0.
blockers.workaround: Keep API 1.0.0 backward compatible with the legacy IdmModbusClient(host) Pymodbus path (implemented + tested); do not use a prerelease.

blockers.description: CodeQL Dependabot PRs #70 and #71 update the paired init/analyze actions separately and fail when applied independently.
blockers.workaround: Treat them as a pair if included at all; do not merge one without the other.

decisions.decision: Keep v0.10.1 and v0.11.0-beta.1 unchanged on the exact API 0.9.1 pin.
decisions.rationale: Released users must retain a reproducible dependency pair.

decisions.decision: Only add-on 0.11.0-beta.2 will explicitly pin idm-heatpump-api[web]==1.0.0.
decisions.rationale: The API and add-on must be promoted as one tested pair.

decisions.decision: The API keeps direct Pymodbus as its backward-compatible default and accepts an optional public raw transport.
decisions.rationale: Standalone and older consumers must keep working while the add-on stops overriding private API internals.

decisions.decision: Stable 1.0.0 (not a prerelease) with backward compatibility as the release gate.
decisions.rationale: User confirmed; strict beta-only resolver isolation is impossible given legacy open requirements.

decisions.decision: Exception-code taxonomy: code 2 permanent; codes 5/6/10/11 transient (retry-in-place, no reconnect, no quarantine); connection/timeout/protocol failures retry with reconnect.
decisions.rationale: Matches Modbus spec semantics and the handoff anti-patterns.

next_action: Run the full CI matrix (Python 3.12/3.13/3.14) and build/twine/wheel checks on Codex/api-1.0.0-transport, then test legacy-consumer compatibility. Only after both pass: bump to 1.0.0, update release metadata, merge, tag, publish, verify. Then hand off to add-on beta.2.
